title: Best Paragliding Spots in India
content:
Best Paragliding Spots in India

Paragliding in India is one of the most thrilling yet affordable adventure sports, offering a perfect blend of adrenaline, scenic beauty, and unforgettable experiences. Imagine soaring high above the mountains, lakes, and valleys while feeling the cool breeze and enjoying breathtaking aerial views-this is exactly what paragliding delivers. From the majestic Himalayas in Himachal Pradesh to the lush green hills of Kerala, India is home to some of the most diverse and budget-friendly paragliding destinations in the world.

Bir Billing, Himachal Pradesh

Why it’s the best:

  • Known as the Paragliding Capital of India
  • Hosted international competitions like the World Cup 
  • Perfect for beginners & professionals

 Price: ₹2,500 - ₹4,500 per flight 
 Duration: 15-30 minutes
 Best Time: October to June

If you want the best experience with good safety, this is your top choice.

Bhimtal / Nainital, Uttarakhand

Why choose this:

  • Best for budget travelers
  • Short but beautiful lake views

Price: ₹1,300 - ₹1,500 
Duration: 3-5 minutes

 This is the cheapest paragliding in India.

Manali (Solang Valley), Himachal Pradesh

Why choose this:

  • Snow-capped mountains view
  • Popular tourist destination

 Price: ₹2,000 - ₹3,500 (varies)
 Best Time: April-June & Sept-Oct

Kamshet, Maharashtra (Best for Beginners)

Why choose this:

  • Certified training schools available
  • Safe for first-time flyers

 Price: ₹2,500 - ₹3,500

Vagamon, Kerala

Why choose this:

  • Green landscapes & peaceful environment
  • Less crowded

 Price: ₹2,500 - ₹3,500

Paragliding Safety Tips (Must Read)

Paragliding is safe only if you follow proper precautions:

Before Booking

  • Always choose certified operators
  • Avoid “too cheap” offers (risk of poor equipment)
  • Check reviews & experience

During Flight

  • Wear helmet & harness properly
  • Follow instructor instructions strictly
  • Don’t panic - it’s a tandem flight (pilot controls everything)

Weather Matters 

  • Avoid flights during
  • Rain
  • Strong winds
  • Fog
  • Good locations like Bir Billing are known for strict safety standards and trained pilot

Paragliding in India is not just an adventure-it’s a once-in-a-lifetime experience. If you want the perfect mix of price, safety, and thrill, start with Bir Billing or go budget-friendly with Bhimtal.
